article.content: Written by Janette Zahia Corcelius & Jane Léonie-Bellay who interviewed students Smeal, Léon, Hamet, & Julia Introduction By Janette Corcelius Janette Zahia Corcelius is a member of the Twin Cities Democratic Socialists of America.
